account.title: Xipher IDE Account

overview.welcomeSubtitle: Your local Xipher IDE console for CLI-first workflows, provider control, and useful operator actions without a backend layer.
overview.planNote: Hosted billing and managed controls come later. For now this stays an honest BYOK flow on top of the open-source CLI.
overview.providersDescription: Active connections are visible immediately, but the raw key never stays in storage.
overview.activityDescription: Pins, statuses, and a quick trail of the latest AI sessions.
overview.emptyProviders: No providers connected yet. Add a safe masked key on the Providers tab.
overview.emptySessions: No sessions yet. Create a local draft to validate the flow.

providers.title: Providers / Keys
providers.subtitle: Connect BYOK providers through the UI. localStorage only receives a safe mask and last4 value, never the raw secret.
providers.keyPlaceholder: Paste an API key. Only a safe mask will be stored.
providers.safeStorage: The raw key is never stored. After confirmation only a mask and safe fingerprint remain.
